amend_note: 603m FAILed the pre-registered gate at G0 ONLY (Stage-0 nursery z_goal>0.4 held 1/3: 0.477/0.389/0.371) while the three load-bearing legs PASSed (P1 survival 3/3, P2 contact 3/3, P2 ecological consumption-gated z_goal 2/3) and both non-vacuity preconditions held (harm_eval range 0.075, reached-P2-alive 3/3). Per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-603m_2026-06-10: z_goal magnitude scales with substrate maturity; for EVERY seed the ecological P2 z_goal exceeds the pre-warmup Stage-0 nursery z_goal, so the mature 0.4 magnitude (identical to G3) under-reads the least-mature stage -- the INVERSE of a substrate-ceiling fingerprint (discrimination legs pass, positive control fails). 603n RECALIBRATES ONLY G0 to a developmentally-appropriate >0.3 positive-control floor (zero-init pre-feed baseline makes this a materially-above-baseline lift), keeping the load-bearing ecological gate G3 STRICT at 0.4 and G1/G2 unchanged. Effectively a confirmation run. PASS = G0 AND G1 AND G2 AND G3 (each >=2/3). Non-vacuity: harm-pathway-discriminative AND reached-P2-alive, else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

pre_registered_gates.g0_definition: Stage-0 forced-feed z_goal_norm_peak > 0.3 -- the goal stream lights NON-TRIVIALLY when fed (the goal-FORMATION positive control at the pre-warmup developmental stage). GoalState is zero-init pre-feed, so peak>0.3 is a materially-above-baseline lift. RECALIBRATED from the 603m mature 0.4 magnitude (which under-read the least-mature stage); the load-bearing ecological gate is NOT loosened.
pre_registered_gates.g1_p1_survival: median episode length over last 10 P1 episodes >= 75 (UNCHANGED)
pre_registered_gates.g3_p2_zgoal_consumption_gated: z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 (the LOAD-BEARING ecological wanting leg; consumption-event-gated, NOT the carried forced-feed nursery trace; STRICT 0.4 -- UNCHANGED, NOT loosened)
pre_registered_gates.g_h_hazard_stage_survival: median episode length over last 10 Stage-H episodes >= 75 (DIAGNOSTIC; NOT in the PASS rule)
pre_registered_gates.pass_rule: PASS = G0 AND G1 AND G2 AND G3 (each >= 2/3 seeds)

hazard_stage_gate.note: diagnostic only -- NOT in the PASS rule (PASS = G0 AND G1 AND G2 AND G3). G_H + harm_eval_range confirm the isolated Stage-H trained the harm pathway.

preconditions.name: harm_pathway_discriminative
preconditions.description: The harm pathway must have trained (>=1 optimizer step) AND harm_eval(z_world) range must lift above the flat ~0.002 603i baseline. Positive control that the survival/P2 legs run on a TRAINED harm landscape, not noise. Below-floor => harm-landscape-noise (603i regression) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a foraging verdict.
preconditions.control: scaffold_train_harm_pathway=True co-trains harm_eval/z_harm/z_harm_a/E2_harm_s in P0+Stage-H; harm_discriminativeness probe measures the post-training harm_eval range over states.

preconditions.name: reached_p2_alive
preconditions.description: P1 survival must clear >=2/3 seeds so the agent reaches P2 ALIVE; otherwise a P2-contact-zero / P2-z_goal-zero read is 'died before contact' not 'foraging incompetence'. Below-floor => the survival leg is still de-risking => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a P2 verdict. (Same statistic as the load-bearing G1 gate leg.)
preconditions.control: P1 survival gate = median episode length over the last 10 P1 episodes >= 75, entered by a Stage-H-survival-competent policy.
